# PaperOrchestra Skills

> PaperOrchestra Skills is an open-source collection of Agent Skills that turns raw research materials (an idea brief and an experimental log) into a submission-ready LaTeX research paper and PDF. It is a skill-native port of Google Research's PaperOrchestra multi-agent paper-writing framework.

## What it does
- Generates a structured paper outline with a figure plan, literature search strategy, and exhaustive citation hints.
- Discovers, verifies, deduplicates, and cites real academic literature using the Semantic Scholar API and a strict research cutoff.
- Generates data plots and conceptual diagrams with a critic-driven revision loop.
- Writes Introduction, Related Work, Method, Experiments, Conclusion, tables, and appendix into a conference LaTeX template.
- Iteratively reviews and refines the manuscript, keeping only revisions that improve a reviewer score, then fixes formatting and compiles the final PDF.
- Evaluates citation precision/recall/F1, literature review quality, overall quality, and side-by-side win rates.

## Key facts
- Format: Agent Skills (SKILL.md + references/ + scripts/).
- Works with Claude Code, opencode, Codex-style agents, and custom runtimes that read SKILL.md.
- Bundled templates: CVPR 2025 (two-column), ICLR 2025 (single-column), generic IEEE conference, neutral arXiv preprint.
- Citation verification: Semantic Scholar with arXiv/Crossref/DBLP fallbacks; exploration ratio > 70; targeted ratio >= 90 plus year/author; abstract required; strict cutoff.
- Leakage gate: blocking by default; detects citations, et al./author-year citations, author identities, and result numbers in idea.md.
- Review: three independent reviewer samples aggregated by mean/median; the writer does not score its own revision.
- Tests: offline pytest suite plus GitHub Actions CI that compiles every bundled template.
- Sample output: examples/paper-project/final_paper.pdf and run_report.json.
- Inputs: idea.md, experimental_log.md, latex_template/ (template.tex, guidelines.md, style files), optional figures.
- Outputs: outline.json, registry.json, citation_map.json, references.bib, figures/, draft .tex, final .tex/.pdf, metrics/.
- No fabricated citations by design: verification is API-grounded and the writer may only cite verified keys.
- Human authors remain responsible for correctness, originality, and submission compliance.

## Install
Clone the repository and run ./install.sh, or symlink any skills/<name> directory into ~/.claude/skills or ~/.config/opencode/skills.

## Skills
- paper-orchestra: full pipeline orchestration and resume.
- paper-inputs: raw-material templates and leakage audit.
- paper-outline: outline.json generation and validation.
- paper-template: CVPR/ICLR/custom LaTeX template scaffolding.
- paper-plotting: plots, diagrams, captions, critic loop.
- paper-literature-review: discovery, verification, BibTeX, Intro/Related Work.
- paper-section-writing: remaining LaTeX sections, tables, figures.
- paper-content-refinement: peer-review loop, formatting pass, final PDF.
- paper-evaluation: citation F1, rubrics, side-by-side aggregation.
